findings.title: Service selects no pods
findings.cause: Service api selects pods with app=api, and no pod in namespace kd-service-selects-deployment-labels has those labels: app=api matches Deployment api's own labels (under its metadata), which its pods do not get; its pods carry app=api-server

evidence.command: kubectl get service api -n kd-service-selects-deployment-labels -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'

evidence.what: Deployment api's own labels match the selector; its pod template's labels are app=api-server

findings.fix: Select the pods by their template's labels (app=api-server), or add app=api to Deployment api's spec.template.metadata.labels: only those labels reach the pods.
